canonical_payload.source: The issuance-time v1-v8 permit binding canonical payload, captured before any dispatch-time or lifecycle mutation.
canonical_payload.subhash_recompute_rule: For v3/v4/v5/v6/v7/v8 payloads carrying spend_scope_hash or delegation_policy_hash, verifiers recompute the hash from exported resource_attributes_json.spend_scope or resource_attributes_json.delegation_policy before accepting the signed decision. For v6/v7/v8 payloads, verifiers additionally require resource_attributes_canonical_hash and recompute SHA-256(rfc8785.dumps(resource_attributes_json)) before accepting the signed decision.
canonical_payload.decision_rule: canonical_payload.decision is the only decision adjudicated by this claim and must be one of allow, deny, or challenge after issuer binding normalization.
canonical_payload.identity_binding: canonical_payload.permit_id and canonical_payload.project_id bind the signed decision to one permit and one project. For v7 and v8, canonical_payload.account_id and canonical_payload.org_id bind the decision to the signed c7 account selector and must be preferred over unsigned manifest account selectors.
canonical_payload.row_state_rule: Verifiers MUST NOT adjudicate a later mutable permit row as the issuance decision unless the pack supplies evidence that the reconstructed payload is the original issuance-time signed payload.
canonical_payload.standing_approval_rule: A permit whose signed canonical_payload.reason is platform_safety_floor.standing_approval_covered (any binding version) had its admin review satisfied by a standing approval; verifiers MUST report it as pre-approved with no per-action review and MUST NOT describe it as human-reviewed. v8 is used only for such permits: it requires reason platform_safety_floor.standing_approval_covered, decision allow, standing_approval_version_id as a lowercase UUID string, and terms_digest as sha256:<64 lowercase hex>. When permit_receipt.standing_approval is present it must be well formed (admin_review satisfied_by_standing_approval, per_action_review false, facts_trust gateway_asserted_keel_authenticated, assurance_level A2), the signed reason must be the covered reason, the signed issued_at must fall in [authorized_at, expires_at), and on v8 its standing_approval_version_id and terms_digest must equal the signed values; otherwise the decision is disproved. Its absence is not an error.

signature.key_resolution: Resolve a permit_binding_signing key from the supplied trust root at binding_issued_at or issued_at; the key id must match the signed payload binding_key_id.

verdicts.supported: canonical payload is present or reconstructable as issuance-time evidence, binding_canonical_hash matches, signature verifies under a trusted permit-binding key, and decision matches the claim request.
verdicts.disproved: canonical bytes or decision disagree with binding_canonical_hash, or a supplied signature fails under the resolved trusted key, or a standing-approval receipt block is malformed, claims coverage the signed reason lacks, or disagrees with a v8 binding.
verdicts.insufficient_evidence: canonical payload fields, binding_canonical_hash, binding_signature, signing time, or trust-root evidence are missing.
verdicts.unverifiable_scope: binding version, canonicalization profile, or trust-root profile is unsupported.
